entries.name: Artwork
entries.description: Artwork thumbnail with aspect ratio presets and gradient overlays.

entries.name: Badge
entries.description: Pill tags for counts, statuses, media flags, and highlights, in two sizes, with a quiet one for pictures.

entries.name: Button
entries.description: Glass pills with spring motion. busy holds it at its width: a spinner takes its first icon's place, or stands over its hidden label.

entries.name: Context Area
entries.description: Right-click interactive context target area wrapper.

entries.name: Context Menu
entries.description: Desktop right-click popup menu with keyboard shortcut badges.

entries.name: Dialog
entries.description: Modal dialog with spring backdrop blur and accessible focus trapping.

entries.name: Dropdown Menu
entries.description: Animated popover menu with radio items, checkboxes with a hint line, submenus and separators.

entries.name: Empty State
entries.description: Placeholder card for zero-data views, missing media, or empty searches.

entries.name: Error State
entries.description: Error state card with a retry button that holds while it runs, its own icon and other ways out.

entries.name: Filter Bar
entries.description: Filter, search, and sort toolbar with animated active filter chips.

entries.name: Hero
entries.description: Full-width hero header banner with glass title and action slots.

entries.name: Input
entries.description: Clean dark text input and labelled field wrappers with an error line. hideLabel keeps the label for screen readers only.

entries.name: Kbd
entries.description: Tactile keyboard shortcut caps with drop shadows and accents.

entries.name: Menu Actions
entries.description: Standardized menu action items with icons and shortcuts.

entries.name: Page
entries.description: Scrollable view layout container with sticky header support.

entries.name: Progress
entries.description: Animated indeterminate and determinate progress bars.

entries.name: Segmented
entries.description: Single-choice segmented switch with sliding spring pill indicator.

entries.name: Select
entries.description: Single-choice select dropdown with popover menu and check indicators.

entries.name: Sheet
entries.description: Side drawer panel that slides smoothly from the screen edge.

entries.name: Shelf
entries.description: Collapsible drawer shelf for tools, properties, and auxiliary widgets.

entries.name: Skeleton
entries.description: Where a card, portrait or line of text will be once it has loaded: the sweep of light, or a still block.

entries.name: Slider
entries.description: Precision scrubber slider for volumes, opacities, and timeline ranges.

entries.name: Switch
entries.description: Binary toggle switch pill with animated sliding knob.

entries.name: Toaster
entries.description: Lightweight dynamic frosted glass notification capsules.

entries.name: Tooltip
entries.description: Instant micro-tooltip that appears on hover with custom offset.

entries.name: Topbar
entries.description: Universal desktop header bar with branding, navigation, and controls.

entries.name: Virtual Grid
entries.description: Virtualized grid for very long lists of pictures. A detail row can open under an item.

entries.name: Banner
entries.description: Message at the top of a view, with its buttons: gold, red or quiet.

entries.name: Checkbox
entries.description: Tick box with its label, for an option that matters once.

entries.name: Settings Group
entries.description: A titled box of setting rows, split by hairlines.

entries.name: Setting Row
entries.description: What a setting is on the left, its control on the right.

entries.name: Path Text
entries.description: A file path as selectable mono text. A right-click shows or copies it.

entries.name: Avatar
entries.description: A character's round face beside their name, with a gold ring for who is in the shot.

entries.name: Card Grid
entries.description: CARD_GRID: the class list of the grid of big cards, for a library's projects or the plugins.

entries.name: Card Menu Button
entries.description: The ⋯ on a card's picture: out of sight until the pointer or the keyboard reaches it.

entries.name: Card Play Button
entries.description: The play button in the corner of a shot's picture, shown on hover or on focus.

entries.name: Confirm Dialog
entries.description: Asks before something goes: Cancel and one answer. It holds while the answer runs and stays open if it fails.

entries.name: Discord Mark
entries.description: Discord's mark as Discord draws it: in colour, black or white, never tinted.

entries.name: Option Row
entries.description: One option in a dialog: what it does, its switch, the whole row as the target.

entries.name: Search Field
entries.description: The pill that finds things in a list. Escape or its cross clears it.

entries.name: Toggle Chip
entries.description: A pill that is on or off, for a filter.

entries.name: Project Card
entries.description: A project as its picture: the title over the footage, its facts beneath.

entries.name: Character Card
entries.description: A character as a portrait: the face fills the card, the name sits on it.

entries.name: Plugin Art
entries.description: A plugin's art at 2:1: its banner, else its icon on a blurred backdrop, else its name set large.

entries.name: Plugin Card
entries.description: An installed plugin as its artwork: how far it is trusted, who it is by, its switch and its menu.

entries.name: Plugins Page
entries.description: Installed plugins and the catalog in two views, with updates, search and who may run code.

entries.name: Uninstall Dialog
entries.description: Asks before a plugin goes, and whether what it kept goes too. It stays open while it runs.

entries.name: Withdrawn Banner
entries.description: Says AutoScene took a plugin back, in AutoScene's words, with Uninstall and Update.

entries.name: Plugin Settings Page
entries.description: A plugin's own screen: its picture as the hero, what it says of itself, then its settings.

entries.name: Catalog Card
entries.description: A plugin the catalog offers: its art, what it may do, and Install or Update.

entries.name: Browse View
entries.description: What the catalog offers as cards, with when it was checked and Check now.

entries.name: Hardware Group
entries.description: What the analysis runs on: the graphics card and NVIDIA acceleration.

entries.name: Fast Scan Notice
entries.description: First-start notice that new projects start with Fast Scan on this computer.

entries.name: Cast Tab
entries.description: The shot under the playhead, who is in it, and everyone in the episode.

entries.name: Details Panel
entries.description: The panel beside the picture: Cast and File tabs and the Player keys button.

entries.name: Shot Header
entries.description: Which shot the playhead is in, its length and range, Mark shot and the steps around it.

entries.name: File Tab
entries.description: The file's name, picture, length, flags, audio track and folder.

entries.name: Tab Body
entries.description: One tab of the details panel: no card around it, with the tab's right-click menu.

entries.name: Player Keys Dialog
entries.description: The player's keys from the keymap, over the player, so they can be tried right after.

showcase.title: Primary Action Pill
showcase.description: White glass CTA pill with inner specular glow and spring press state.

showcase.title: Accent Gold Button
showcase.description: AutoScene brand gold with subtle backdrop glow for focal actions.

showcase.title: Frosted Glass Pill
showcase.description: Translucent backdrop pill designed to float over media footage.

showcase.title: Danger Destructive Pill
showcase.description: Muted crimson border with red glow hover for irreversible deletes.

showcase.title: Segmented Sliding Tabs
showcase.description: Spring-animated sliding tab switcher with zero layout shift.

showcase.title: Hardware Switch
showcase.description: High-contrast boolean switch with fluid thumb glide.

showcase.title: Confidence Slider
showcase.description: Continuous drag threshold slider with live numeric chip feedback.

showcase.title: Glass Form Input
showcase.description: Controlled text input with border focus states and placeholder styling.

showcase.title: Search Bar with Icon
showcase.description: Search bar with embedded magnifying glass icon and keyboard shortcut.

showcase.title: Character Profile Card
showcase.description: Square actor profile card with clip badge and action menu trigger.

showcase.title: Export Summary Card
showcase.description: Export summary card with playback trigger and video format details.

showcase.title: Status Badges & Tags
showcase.description: Semantic badge pills designed for status updates and timeline verification.

showcase.title: Progress Bar
showcase.description: Determinate percentage progress bar and indeterminate scanning beam.

showcase.title: Keyboard Shortcut Caps
showcase.description: Physical specular keyboard shortcut caps for keybinding references.

showcase.title: Dropdown Action Menu
showcase.description: Glass floating context menu with item icons and destructive action separator.

showcase.title: Hero Display Header
showcase.description: Backdrop header designed for project and episode hero banners.
